title: Standard rule sets: ASD-STE100 and Plain Language
description: Ship two standard editorial rule sets as Limatus starter policy packs, beside ai-writing-tells, so a CMS can copy and edit them: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (ports PR #45 / LIM-501c5c from the retired diagnose engine onto policy packs) and the US Federal Plain Language Guidelines (plainlanguage.gov, archived; now digital.gov/guides/plain-language). Shared built-in checks (sentence and paragraph length, reading grade, double negatives, undefined acronyms, procedure-step rules, -ing forms, articles, one word one meaning) live in builtin_checks and serve both packs. The real ASD-STE100 dictionary is licensed and is not bundled; the pack carries #45's synthetic seed.
